list.label: Contributor

list.name: team

options.content:
There is no single productivity number

Productivity is output divided by effort, and teams disagree about both terms. Rather than choose one definition, this reports the same data under five and shows the spread. Read the row matching how your team counts.

Every figure here is a difference, not a gain. AI-assisted and unassisted commits are self-selected, not randomised — nothing on this page supports a causal claim. Commits with no evidence collected are excluded rather than counted as unassisted. Check the rework rate before reading any output figure.

panels.title: Five definitions of the same difference
panels.description: Output divided by effort, five ways, each drawn from the same zero line. Bars right of zero favour assisted work, left favour unassisted. The spread is the finding: pick the definition your team uses. Difference, not gain — cohorts are self-selected. A bar is absent when either side has under 5 commits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn, c.files_changed AS files,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team,
         c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000)) AS d
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) total_lines, SUM(files) files,
         COUNT(DISTINCT person, d) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY status
),
n AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN commits END) na,
             MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu FROM agg)
SELECT d.definition AS metric,
       CASE WHEN d.u > 0 AND n.na >= 5 AND n.nu >= 5 THEN ROUND(100*(d.a-d.u)/d.u,0) END AS value
FROM (
  SELECT 'Commits per person-day' definition, 1 ord,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines per person-day', 2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN total_lines/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN total_lines/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines per commit', 3,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN total_lines/NULLIF(commits,0) END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN total_lines/NULLIF(commits,0) END) FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Files per commit', 4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN files/NULLIF(commits,0) END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN files/NULLIF(commits,0) END) FROM agg
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Files per person-day', 5,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN files/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN files/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) FROM agg
) d CROSS JOIN n ORDER BY d.ord

panels.title: Pooled vs conditioned
panels.description: The same difference computed two ways. Pooled compares all assisted work against all unassisted work. Conditioned compares only like with like — same work type, same complexity band — and reweights onto a common mix. The gap between them is how much of the pooled figure was the mix of work each cohort picked up, rather than how productive it was. Neither is a verdict; both are differences between self-selected cohorts. Output here is lines delivered, not commits: inside a single work-type and complexity cell most contributor-days hold one commit, so a commit count pins both sides near 1 and measures the grid rather than the work.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         c.contributor, c.committed_at
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
cell AS (
  SELECT purpose, band, status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY purpose, band, status
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT purpose, band,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM cell GROUP BY purpose, band
),
tot AS (
  SELECT status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(contributor,'|',DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(committed_at/1000000000)))) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 'Unconditioned — all work pooled' AS metric,
       ROUND(100*(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END)
                - MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END))
             / MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),0) AS value
FROM tot
UNION ALL
-- Weighted by the unassisted cohort's mix, so the strata are compared on a
-- common composition rather than each cohort's own.
SELECT 'Conditioned — same work type and complexity',
       ROUND(100*(SUM(a*nu)/SUM(nu) - SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)) / (SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)),0)
FROM pivot WHERE na >= 5 AND nu >= 5 AND u > 0

panels.title: Rework rate, each side
panels.description: Share of commits whose purpose is a fix. A difference in output means nothing if it arrives with more rework, so read this before any row of the table. This is a fix RATE, not a defect rate — it counts commits labelled fix, not bugs found. Compares two measured cohorts only: commits with no evidence collected (undetermined, uninstrumented, unmatched, degraded) are excluded, not counted as unassisted — that would report absence as a measured negative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN c.status='assisted' THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'Unassisted' END AS metric,
       ROUND(100*SUM(c.purpose='fix')/COUNT(*),1) AS value
FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
  AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six statuses are named so this set stays complete as dun's list
    -- grows. Only two are compared: the other four mean no evidence was
    -- collected, and counting them as unassisted would report absence as a
    -- measured negative (NAV-21). CASE maps them to NULL, which drops them.
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
GROUP BY c.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

panels.title: Conditioned on work type and complexity
Difference by work type × complexity
panels.description: Lines delivered per person-day, assisted against unassisted, inside each cell. Green favours assisted, red favours unassisted, grey means under 5 commits on a side and withheld. Cells disagreeing in colour are the point: no single figure describes that data, and the pooled number was measuring the mix. The n columns give both cohort sizes.

WITH c AS (

    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
cell AS (
  SELECT purpose, band, status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered,
         COUNT(DISTINCT person, d) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY purpose, band, status
),
pv AS (
  SELECT purpose, band,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM cell GROUP BY purpose, band
),
dlt AS (
  SELECT purpose, band,
    CASE WHEN na >= 5 AND nu >= 5 AND u > 0 THEN ROUND(100*(a-u)/u,0) END delta,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(na,0),'/',COALESCE(nu,0)) n
  FROM pv
)
SELECT purpose AS `Work type`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN band='1-2 files'  THEN delta END) AS `1-2 files`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN band='3-20 files' THEN delta END) AS `3-20 files`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN band='20+ files'  THEN delta END) AS `20+ files`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN band='1-2 files'  THEN n END) AS `n 1-2`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN band='3-20 files' THEN n END) AS `n 3-20`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN band='20+ files'  THEN n END) AS `n 20+`
FROM dlt
WHERE purpose IN ('feature','fix','refactor','test','docs')
GROUP BY purpose
ORDER BY FIELD(purpose,'feature','fix','refactor','test','docs')

panels.title: How change size is distributed, each side

Commits above 2,000 lines are cut from the plot so the bins stay readable — the means on the headline row include them.

  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')

SELECT CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN churn END AS `AI-assisted`,
       CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN churn END AS `Unassisted`
FROM c
WHERE churn BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

panels.title: Own difference — assisted vs unassisted, same person
panels.description: For each person: lines per active day on their assisted commits, against the same on their unassisted commits. Holding the person constant removes the confounder the cohort comparison cannot — who chose to use the tool. If most bars point one way, that is stronger evidence than any pooled figure. Needs 5 commits each side.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team,
         c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000)) AS d
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
pp AS (
  SELECT person, team, status, COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered,
         COUNT(DISTINCT d) days
  FROM c GROUP BY person, team, status
),
pv AS (
  SELECT person, team,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN delivered/NULLIF(days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM pp GROUP BY person, team
)
SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1),' · ',team) AS person,
       ROUND(100*(a-u)/u,0) AS `own difference %`
FROM pv
WHERE na >= 5 AND nu >= 5 AND u > 0
ORDER BY `own difference %` DESC

panels.title: Does heavier use go with more output?
panels.description: One bar per person, ordered left to right by the share of their commits that were assisted. Bar height is lines per active day across all their commits. Bars rising left to right say heavier users deliver more per day; a flat row says use and output are unrelated here. Either way it is a correlation across self-selected people, not an effect. Needs 10 commits per person. The axis is logarithmic, so bars are comparable when one person sits far above the rest.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team,
         c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000)) AS d
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
pp AS (
  SELECT person, team,
         100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share,
         SUM(churn)/COUNT(DISTINCT d) per_day,
         COUNT(*) commits
  FROM c GROUP BY person, team
)
-- People sorted by how much of their work was assisted, left to right.
-- The bar is their output per active day. Rising left-to-right says the
-- two move together; flat says they do not. Correlation across
-- self-selected people, not an effect.
SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1),' · ',ROUND(share,0),'% assisted') AS person,
       ROUND(per_day,0) AS `lines per active day`
FROM pp WHERE commits >= 10
ORDER BY share

panels.title: Pooled and conditioned, week by week
panels.description: The two headline figures recomputed each week. The gap between the lines is the mix effect over time — how much of the pooled figure each week was which work got picked up. Conditioned uses 3 commits a side per cell at week grain, pooled uses 5; a week that clears neither is a gap, not zero.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.purpose,
         CASE WHEN c.files_changed < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN c.files_changed <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         c.status, c.lines_added + c.lines_removed AS churn,
         COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team,
         c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1000000000)) AS d
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
),
wk AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(d) DAY) AS week, purpose, band, status,
         COUNT(*) commits, SUM(churn) delivered, COUNT(DISTINCT person, d) person_days
  FROM c GROUP BY week, purpose, band, status
),
tot AS (
  SELECT week, status, SUM(commits) commits, SUM(delivered) delivered,
         SUM(person_days) person_days
  FROM wk GROUP BY week, status
),
pooled AS (
  SELECT week,
    ROUND(100*(MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END)
              -MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END))
            / MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END),0) v
  FROM tot GROUP BY week
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted' THEN commits END) >= 5
     AND MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) >= 5
),
pv AS (
  SELECT week, purpose, band,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) a,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN delivered/NULLIF(person_days,0) END) u,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='assisted'   THEN commits END) na,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='unassisted' THEN commits END) nu
  FROM wk GROUP BY week, purpose, band
),
cond AS (
  SELECT week, ROUND(100*(SUM(a*nu)/SUM(nu) - SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)) / (SUM(u*nu)/SUM(nu)),0) v
  FROM pv WHERE na >= 3 AND nu >= 3 AND u > 0 GROUP BY week
)
SELECT CAST(p.week AS DATETIME) AS time, p.v AS `Pooled`, cnd.v AS `Conditioned`
FROM pooled p LEFT JOIN cond cnd ON cnd.week = p.week
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Lines per person-day, by week and weekday
panels.description: Delivered lines per person-day, both cohorts together, laid out as weeks across and weekdays down. Shows the working rhythm the averages hide — and whether the heavy days cluster.

  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded')
    -- All six named so the set stays complete as dun's list grows; only two
    -- are compared, because the other four mean no evidence was collected
    -- and counting them as unassisted reports absence as a measured
    -- negative (NAV-21).
    AND CASE c.status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 WHEN 'unassisted' THEN 1 END = 1 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')

SELECT CAST(DATE_SUB(d, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(d) DAY) AS DATETIME) AS time,
       DAYNAME(d) AS metric,
       ROUND(SUM(churn)/COUNT(DISTINCT person, d),0) AS value
FROM c
GROUP BY time, metric, WEEKDAY(d)
ORDER BY time, WEEKDAY(d)

panels.title: Cycle time per stratum, where the issue data supports it
panels.description: Mean days from issue creation to resolution, split by work type and complexity. This is the grain the productivity formula is usually stated on, and it is much thinner than the commit grain — most strata have under 5 issues a side and are omitted entirely. An empty chart here means not enough issues, not no difference.

targets.rawSql:
WITH iss AS (
  SELECT i.id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN w.status='assisted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) assisted,
         MIN(w.purpose) purpose,
         CASE WHEN SUM(w.files_changed) < 3 THEN '1-2 files'
              WHEN SUM(w.files_changed) <= 20 THEN '3-20 files'
              ELSE '20+ files' END band,
         TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, i.created_date, i.resolution_date)/24 days
  FROM issues i
  JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = w.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, w.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE i.status = 'DONE' AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
    -- Bare-integer keys on some trackers match unrelated commits, so the
    -- join is guarded to the PROJECT-123 shape (check-issue-key-guard.py).
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date)
    AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY i.id
)
SELECT CONCAT(purpose,' · ',band) AS metric,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN assisted=1 THEN days END),2) AS `AI-assisted`,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN assisted=0 THEN days END),2) AS `Unassisted`
FROM iss
GROUP BY purpose, band
HAVING SUM(assisted=1) >= 5 OR SUM(assisted=0) >= 5
ORDER BY metric
